node.title: Quartic-coset biform lift obstruction for the rate-half type-2 FR countermodel
node.statement: For the four-copy quartic incidence countermodel, any coset-preserving identification (i,x) -> tau_i x with the smooth domain mu_(16m) is incompatible with a biform of parameter degree m and locator degree at most rho=4m-1, even after arbitrary nonzero row scaling. The leading two parameter coefficients would give degree-at-most-rho polynomials A,B with B(tau_i x)=xA(tau_i x) on three full mu_(4m) cosets; root counting forces A=B=0. Thus the pinned m=64 incidence witness has no natural degree-255 apolar-biform lift. Arbitrary point permutations and the general algebraic FR statement remain open.
